title: control/<request id>.json
description: R-D8: one steering request per file in control/, also the shape of the files moved to control/done/ and control/refused/. The v1 vocabulary: set {param, value}, checkpoint, stop {after?}, pause, resume, step, until {step}. The plan names set, checkpoint, stop, pause, and (from Cactus HTTPD) single step and until-step-N; `resume` is added here because pause is useless without it. `stop.after` is `checkpoint` (checkpoint, then stop) or `now`. `id` is optional in the body; run-check verifies it equals the file name stem when present. A file in control/refused/ must carry a `reason` (checked by run-check).

reason.description: Why the code refused the request (e.g. the parameter is not `always`).
